title: JA Diner WordPress 7 1.0.3 is published and pinned with a contract that leaves no demo business words in a writable place
steps: S1: Read the content map of contracts/ja-diner/wp7/1.0.3 and count slots without a role, fact-role slots without a group, and text slots whose role is editorial but whose sample is a phone, email, address, price or hours.
S2: Read the footer template part of the wp-ja-diner overlay and list the named blocks whose words are prose.
S3: Read apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts.json for quickstart/ja-diner/wp7 and compare its Claude Cowork pin with the plugin carrying the contract (contracts gate).
expect: S1: 0 slots without a role, 0 fact slots without a group, 0 editorial slots with a fact sample.
S2: none (the address is the {contact.address} token in its own named paragraph, the link label sits in an unnamed one).
S3: version 1.0.3 pinned on a Claude Cowork plugin whose carried contract matches this tree.
evidence: Before this change the published 1.0.1 left the footer address, the hours lines and the chef and dish pictures as demo words a customer could not rewrite
fence: Static read of the committed contract, the theme overlay and the pin; the readiness verdict and the sweep measure the built site
